failsafe.text: Always resume by reading STATE.json and continue at NEXT_NODE.
After each node: update STATE.json + CHECKLIST_TODO.md + CHECKLIST_DONE.md + ANALYSE_LOG.md.
Keep changes bundled per file (touch files once).
If shell/Gradle issues appear: write them to ERROR.MD and follow its quick fixes.
Additional Tasks IDs must use the pattern NODE_xxx__AT_### and must never be renumbered once created.
When fixing compile errors: fix the first error only, re-run the same task, repeat until clean (no batch refactors).
If Gradle wrapper/download fails, document the exact error in ERROR.MD and switch to the provided local Gradle distribution path.

guardrails.text: No scope creep outside the defined editor-schema-preview-runtime hook.
No renaming files unless explicitly requested.
Keep project paths relative to the workspace; ignore Git/GitHub.
Ignore files containing 'ARBEITSPLAN' in the filename unless explicitly required for a task.
Avoid touching build/ and .gradle/ outputs except in packaging nodes (NODE_98+).

tasks.label: Schema model baseline
tasks.description: Define and persist the biome/schema data model used by both editor and runtime (config/biomes.json). Must be safe on corruption (fallback + rewrite) and must cover zones, masks, spawn rules and POI templates.

additionalTasks.text: Verify BiomeSystem.LOCAL_PATH is config/biomes.json and loadOrCreate() creates defaults when missing/corrupt.
Verify schema fields exist in BiomeDef: groundId, roadsEnabled, edgeWidthTiles, edgeGroundOverride, customZones, zoneMasks, spawnRules, poiTemplates.
Verify BiomeSystem.save() writes UTF-8 pretty JSON and does not crash game on parse errors (fallback to defaults).

tasks.label: Zone shape encoding
tasks.description: Encode zone shapes deterministically (core/edge/custom/mask). Custom zones use mask PNGs; runtime queries alpha>0 and editor can save/reload masks without losing identity.

additionalTasks.text: Verify zone mask representation uses ZoneMaskDef{name,file} and BiomeSystem.zoneMaskAt() correctly reads alpha > 0.
Verify BiomeSystem.writeZoneMaskPng() writes under config/biome_masks with sanitized biome+zone names.
Verify zone mask caching (zoneMaskCache) is invalidated on setBiomeDef() and editor reloads masks per biome.

tasks.label: Editor accumulator
tasks.description: In-editor accumulation layer: collect stamps/brush edits per active zone and provide deterministic derivation helpers (stamps -> density/count rules). No raw stamp positions are persisted to JSON.

additionalTasks.text: Verify BiomeEditorScreen keeps stamps/overlays per active zone and shows counts (trees/stones/zone pixels/road tiles).
Verify deriveRuleFromStamps() produces a deterministic rule update based on stamps within the active zone.
Verify editor does not write raw stamp positions into JSON (only derived rules + masks).

tasks.label: Editor save/load
tasks.description: Biome editor save/load must operate schema-only: apply JSON fragment for one biome, save full config/biomes.json, reload and restore UI state, while keeping preview deterministic.

additionalTasks.text: Verify 'Apply JSON' path parses a single-biome JSON fragment and updates BiomeSystem in-memory without crashing.
Verify Save writes BiomeSystem.toJson() to config/biomes.json and persists zoneMasks references.
Verify editor can reload config/biomes.json and reconstruct UI state (selected biome + active zone + masks).

tasks.label: Map preview from schema
tasks.description: Preview renderer generates visible chunks purely from the schema (no hand-painted tiles). Preview must be deterministic via per-biome previewSeed and reflect zone masks/roads/spawns.

additionalTasks.text: Verify previewWorldSeed() uses per-biome previewSeed when available, otherwise stable fallback seed.
Verify preview world regeneration rebuilds chunks (ensurePreviewChunksExist) and shows schema-driven ground/roads/spawns.
Verify template preview mode (single biome forced) vs mixed preview behavior is consistent and deterministic per seed.

tasks.label: Runtime hook
tasks.description: Runtime world generation and spawners must consume the same schema (roads + spawn rules + zone masks). Newly generated chunks must reflect edited config without breaking existing saves.

additionalTasks.text: Verify WorldNodeSpawner uses BiomeSystem spawn rules and respects zone masks/edge bands when spawning.
Verify runtime roads mask is computed deterministically via BiomeSystem.buildRoadMaskForChunk / isRoadAtGlobalTile.
Verify biome config changes affect newly generated chunks without corrupting existing saves.

tasks.label: Editor consistency pass
tasks.description: Consistency pass over the editor: UI state transitions, resource lifecycle (Pixmap/Texture), zone naming safety, and regen logic must be stable for long sessions.

additionalTasks.text: Verify editor UI state transitions are safe: switching biome/zone, toggling overlays, regenerating preview.
Verify Pixmap/Texture lifecycle is safe (dispose/refresh) to avoid memory leaks during long editing sessions.
Verify sanitizeZoneName() prevents invalid filenames / JSON keys.

tasks.label: Sanity checks (no build)
tasks.description: Static verification without compiling: file structure, asset presence, entry scripts, and obvious syntax anomalies. Prepare for first build.

additionalTasks.text: Static scan: search for obvious syntax errors / missing imports (no compile).
Static scan: verify start scripts exist (Roadmap/Game/BiomeEditor/AssetEditor) and point to expected Gradle tasks.
Static scan: verify assets referenced by UI exist under assets/ (fonts/ui.ttf, ui/title.png, ui/mainmenu_bg.png, ui/cursor_crosshair.png).

tasks.label: Build + run (first real compile)
tasks.description: First real compile/run. Goal: get a clean desktop build launching both Game and Biome Editor, and produce a server distribution (installDist) without starting full integration work yet.

additionalTasks.text: Confirm JDK 17 is used (JAVA_HOME / java -version) and Gradle wrapper runs.
Decide Gradle distribution strategy: wrapper download vs local gradle zip; document the choice in ERROR.MD if wrapper fails.
Run desktop compile+run once: gradlew.bat :desktop:run (from project root). Capture first runtime error stacktrace if any.
Run Biome Editor entry: gradlew.bat :desktop:run --args="--biome-editor" (or START_4_BIOME_EDITOR.bat). Verify window opens and renders preview.
If atlas is missing or empty: run gradlew.bat packAtlas (assets/atlas/src -> assets/atlas/game.atlas + game.png), then rerun.
Run dedicated server distribution build: gradlew.bat :server:installDist (do NOT start it yet, only ensure distribution is created).
Open build/reports/problems/problems-report.html after build (if generated) and link it in ERROR.MD for NODE_91.

tasks.label: Fix compile errors
tasks.description: Iteratively eliminate compile/link issues across core/desktop/server. Also fix schema correctness issues discovered by static analysis that would break runtime (e.g., wrong JSON fields).

additionalTasks.text: Fix errors iteratively: always resolve the FIRST javac error, then re-run the same Gradle task; repeat until clean.
BiomeSystem schema bugfix: ensure BiomeDef serializes/deserializes previewSeed correctly AND reads groundId from "groundId" (not "previewSeed").
Desktop launcher args: extend DesktopLauncher/SurvivalGame to support modes beyond biome editor (asset editor, asset index) without breaking existing start scripts.
Multiplayer UI compile sanity: ensure MultiplayerScreen join dialog and session code compile and do not reference missing assets/regions.
Server module sanity: ensure com.yourgame.survival.server.DedicatedServerMain is on classpath and server/build.gradle mainClass matches the package.
Resolve library/version mismatches that can break tooling (e.g., gdxVersion in root build.gradle vs bundled libs) if they block build tasks like packAtlas.
Once compile passes: run :desktop:classes and :server:classes explicitly to confirm both graphs compile cleanly.

tasks.label: Smoke test: asset editor
tasks.description: Make the Asset Editor tool reachable and usable: atlas load, code-scan index, collision meta editing and save, plus an optional 'asset index' batch mode.

additionalTasks.text: Wire entrypoint: ensure START_5_ASSET_EDITOR.bat actually launches AssetEditorScreen (command-line switch must route to it).
Atlas load check: AssetEditorScreen must see atlas/game.atlas regions; if empty, fix packAtlas pipeline first.
Index scan check: AssetIndexScanner must find atlas region references in code (no false positives outside atlas).
UI functional pass: list scroll, kind filter, search, selection updates preview + info labels.
Collision pipeline pass: pipette BG, tolerance slider, recompute, verify draft vs actual collision overlays behave and never crash on transparent sprites.
Save pass: 2-click confirm works; MetaIO writes sidecar meta next to source asset; reopen editor and verify meta reload.
Asset index mode: make START_2_ASSET_INDEX.bat work (define what "--asset-editor#" does: generate/report index and exit).

tasks.label: Smoke test: game client
tasks.description: End-to-end client smoke test: main menu, gameplay entry, save/load entry points, multiplayer join UI, and biome editor save->runtime effect verification.

additionalTasks.text: Run START_3_GAME.bat. Verify main menu renders (title + background), buttons respond, and no missing asset exceptions.
Start New Game: verify GameScreen enters world, player controls work, and no immediate null-pointer spam in console.
Open Tutorial/Options/Credits screens once each to catch missing UI regions/assets early.
Open Multiplayer menu: verify join dialog works (IP/Port edit, connect/cancel) and session status messages display.
Run Biome Editor (START_4_BIOME_EDITOR.bat): verify zone mask paint/edit, apply JSON, save config/biomes.json, reload editor and confirm persistence.
Regression check: after saving biome config, start New Game again and verify runtime uses updated biome settings (groundId/roads/spawns).

tasks.label: Asset audit: remove debug art
tasks.description: Audit and clean assets for release: remove placeholders/debug art, ensure every referenced region exists, repack atlas, and verify UI/data assets ship cleanly.

additionalTasks.text: Generate 'IST index' report (from AssetIndexScanner) and compare against atlas regions: list missing regions and unused regions.
Search for placeholder/debug regions by heuristics (solid-color, text labels, obvious dev sprites) and replace or remove them safely.
Re-pack atlas (packAtlas) and verify no runtime code still references removed regions (fix references, not with silent fallbacks).
Audit UI textures loaded via Gdx.files.internal (ui/*.png, fonts/*.ttf, terrain/*): verify all exist and are in the release package.
Collision meta audit: ensure every ENTITY/TILE that needs collision has a meta entry (or a deterministic auto-collision rule).
Remove/ignore stale build artifacts (build/reports, old atlases) from the final release zip to keep size and confusion down.

tasks.label: Performance pass
tasks.description: Performance + stability pass: avoid per-frame allocations, validate cache bounds, ensure Pixmap/Texture disposal, and validate FPS stability in long sessions.

additionalTasks.text: Stability run: 10–20 minutes play session; watch for memory growth and GC spikes (especially Pixmap/Texture creation).
Hotspot scan: ensure no per-frame allocations in render loops (new Vector2/StringBuilder/arrays inside render).
Chunk/biome generation: verify caches (roadMaskCache, zoneMaskCache) have bounded size and are cleared on config changes.
Asset editor: verify atlas and pixmaps are disposed correctly when screen is closed or selection changes.
Optional: add simple FPS + alloc counters toggle (dev-only) and remove/disable for release if desired.

tasks.label: Regression: save/load
tasks.description: Regression suite for biome schema and world saves: round-trip integrity, backwards compatibility, corruption fallback, and correct write locations under different run dirs.

additionalTasks.text: Biome schema regression: edit biome, save, restart app, reload, confirm preview matches and JSON round-trips without drift.
World save/load regression: create a save, exit to menu, load same slot, confirm world/position/inventory persist.
Backwards compatibility check: load an older save (if available) and ensure missing schema fields fall back safely.
Corruption handling: intentionally break config/biomes.json and confirm BiomeSystem falls back to defaults without crash and rewrites a valid file.
Path correctness: verify files are written to the intended run folder (assets workingDir vs project root) and document it.

tasks.label: Smoke test: dedicated server
tasks.description: Dedicated server smoke test: build installDist, start server, verify protocol (PING/JOIN), connect from client, handle disconnect/shutdown cleanly.

additionalTasks.text: Run server/server/start_dedicated_server.bat. Confirm it builds installDist and starts listening on 0.0.0.0:7777.
Connectivity test: from another terminal, connect via telnet/netcat and send PING/JOIN; verify protocol responses.
Client test: from game, use MultiplayerScreen join dialog to connect to 127.0.0.1:7777 and verify WORLD_INIT + PLAYER_SPAWN handled.
UI wiring: replace 'Dedicated Server (noch nicht implementiert)' toast with an actual action (open join dialog with default port or auto-connect).
Shutdown behavior: stop server using stop_dedicated_server.bat; ensure client detects closure cleanly (onClosed callback).

tasks.label: Release packaging
tasks.description: Create release-grade zip(s): desktop runnable distribution + server distribution + required assets/config, with traceability docs; verify from a clean unzip.

additionalTasks.text: Create desktop distribution: gradlew.bat :desktop:distZip (or custom zip) and verify it launches with bundled assets.
Create server distribution: :server:installDist output + start scripts; verify running from a clean folder works.
Package assets/config + atlas + audio + fonts + ui + data; confirm no absolute paths are required at runtime.
Include Roadmap UI + STATE/CHECKLIST files for traceability; exclude heavy caches (.gradle, build/) unless explicitly needed.
Final smoke: unzip into a fresh folder, run START_3_GAME.bat and START_4_BIOME_EDITOR.bat successfully (no IDE).

tasks.label: Backup + tag
tasks.description: Final backup + tagging: freeze a snapshot, update roadmap state to finished, and write release notes / analysis log for the shipped version.

additionalTasks.text: Create final backup zip snapshot (full project + release artifacts) named with the current Stable version.
Update STATE.json (LAST_COMPLETED_NODE, NEXT_NODE='—', VERSION_NOTE) and move NODEs into CHECKLIST_DONE.md.
Append ANALYSE_LOG.md with a dated release entry: what changed, known issues, and verification steps executed.
Optionally create a short CHANGELOG section in README_ROADMAP.md (or a new RELEASE_NOTES.md) for the shipped build.
